title: Typed contract
responsibility: Lists typed inputs, outputs and errors with compact example previews and full details in a shared modal.

inputs.name: EntityContract.unit
inputs.description: The entity at the selected revision, including the fields and examples its contract records.

inputs.name: EntityContract.category
inputs.description: The kind of entity; config outputs are labelled Provides.

inputs.name: EntityContract.contract
inputs.description: Prepared contract facts such as purpose, route, required states and execution targets.

inputs.name: EntityContract.last
inputs.description: Optional parent commit when the selected revision removed this entity.

outputs.name: EntityContract
outputs.description: Name, type and example tables with ellipsis for long previews. Trailing info controls open all examples and the field description in the shared modal.
